Well, there is a typo, it should be

``` php
'cache' => array(
              'useMemcached' => true,
              'class' => 'MemCache',
              'servers' => array(
                  array(
                      'host' => '192.168.1.182',
                      'port' => 11211,
                      'weight' => 40,
                  ),
                  array(
                      'host' => '192.168.1.183',
                      'port' => 11211,
                      'weight' => 60,
                  ),
              ),
          ),
```

Just another thing, for session handling I would advise using one Memcached and/or enabling stickiness from your loadbalancer to your backend. In case a users cached session object is stored on .183 and your app switches to .182, then you have a user without his session. That is if you don't have an awesome Memcached replicator amongst your daemons, which I doubt you or any of us does :)

The typo is in `useMemcached`, you had it as `useMemCahed`, due to that typo the app is set to use memcache, and not memcached.

P.S. I did not understand you had memcached in cluster configuration, I thought it was LoadBalancer --> cluster of Apache daemons ---> Memcache daemons. Disregard my comment regarding replication, you are fine.
